instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Sometimes you can see a rainbow in the sky. For a rainbow you need sun and rain. The colours of the rainbow are: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and purple.

atoms.text: A leprechaun is a fabulous creature that lives at the end of the rainbow. He wears dark green clothes and has orange hair. He has a black pot of gold.
